description: This file defines a Flutter widget representing a shopping cart page in a mobile application, including UI layout, interaction logic for cart items, and order completion.

classes.name: CartPage
classes.description: A stateless widget displaying the user's shopping cart, allowing quantity adjustments, item removal, and order checkout.

classes.name: _Summary
classes.description: A sub-widget presenting the total amount and a checkout button.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree for the cart page, displaying cart items or an empty message, and handles order navigation.
